# Backup

From sources/options.md, prices as of 1 March 2026.

## Recommendation

Use Vaultline Team at $14 a month.

- It covers three computers, and the shop has two.
- 1 TB is more than three times the 300 GB to be stored.
- Deleted files are kept for 90 days, so a file from two months ago can be recovered.

Stashbox covers one computer only. Irongate is built for a much bigger office. Bao will set it up.
